item.description:
ABOUT MYSELF

Heyyyy… Aishwarya here. Most people call me Aishu. I’m an undergraduate student pursuing Biology in Azim Premji University. I like understanding how things work like cells, system, brain, habit. Biology is my core but I also enjoy coding, manupulating data and making graphs with R. I also run marathon as it is something which helps in buildinga displined life. I enjoy running with my running club friends outside campus while enjoying the striking scenary. It teaches me patience consistency and also humitity.
